title: Tempstar Furnace Code 2 Flash: Pressure switch was closed at the wrong time
meaning: The pressure switch was closed when the control expected it to be open.
commonCauses: A pressure switch stuck closed
A pinched or incorrectly connected pressure hose
Shorted pressure-switch wiring or a control fault
diySteps: Turn furnace power off for five minutes and do not bypass or jumper the pressure switch.
Check only the outdoor vent openings for obvious snow, ice, leaves, or nests before restoring power once.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the code returns; the switch, hose, wiring, and inducer draft need testing.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 2 Flash means the pressure switch was closed when the control expected it to be open on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: ICP control boards covered by document 44001202103 and using its 2–10 flash table.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 3 Flash: Pressure-switch circuit did not close
meaning: The low-pressure switch was open when the control expected it to be closed.
commonCauses: A blocked intake or exhaust vent
A restricted condensate drain or pressure hose
A weak inducer motor or pressure switch
diySteps: With the furnace off, check outdoor intake and exhaust openings for snow, ice, leaves, or nests.
Replace a visibly dirty air filter, restore power once, and note whether the code returns.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the vent is clear and the pressure-switch code returns; combustion-air testing requires instruments.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 3 Flash means the low-pressure switch was open when the control expected it to be closed on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: ICP control boards covered by document 44001202103 and using its 2–10 flash table.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 4 Flash: Limit or rollout circuit open
meaning: The limit or flame-rollout circuit is open.
commonCauses: A blocked flue or combustion-air path
A burner or gas-pressure problem
A damaged or restricted heat exchanger
whenToCallPro: Leave the furnace off and call a licensed technician for a combustion-safety inspection.
dangerNote: Keep the furnace off. Do not reset a rollout switch. If you smell gas or a carbon-monoxide alarm sounds, leave the building and contact emergency services or the gas utility.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 4 Flash means the limit or flame-rollout circuit is open on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: ICP control boards covered by document 44001202103 and using its 2–10 flash table.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 5 Flash: Flame detected when the gas valve should be off
meaning: The control detected flame while the gas valve should have been off.
commonCauses: A gas valve leaking or stuck open
A shorted flame-sensing circuit
A failed integrated control board
whenToCallPro: Turn the furnace off and call a licensed technician immediately to test the gas valve and flame-proving circuit.
dangerNote: Turn the furnace off and do not reset it. If you smell gas, leave the building without operating switches and contact the gas utility or emergency services from outside.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 5 Flash means the control detected flame while the gas valve should have been off on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: ICP control boards covered by document 44001202103 and using its 2–10 flash table.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 6 Flash: Ignition or flame-sense failure
meaning: The burners failed to ignite, or the flame signal was lost during operation.
commonCauses: A dirty or weak flame sensor
Unstable gas pressure or burner flame
Poor grounding or flame-sensor wiring
diySteps: Confirm the gas shutoff has not been moved and the furnace panel is fully seated.
Try one reset and watch whether the burners light and then shut off again.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if flame drops out again or ignition becomes delayed or noisy.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 6 Flash means the burners failed to ignite, or the flame signal was lost during operation on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: ICP control boards covered by document 44001202103 and using its 2–10 flash table.

title: Tempstar Furnace Code 10 Flash: Power polarity or grounding fault
meaning: The furnace detected reversed line polarity, or incorrect transformer phasing on twinned units.
commonCauses: Reversed line and neutral wiring
A missing or poor equipment ground
Incorrect transformer phasing on twinned furnaces
diySteps: Turn the furnace off at its service switch.
Do not alter line-voltage wiring or grounding connections yourself.
whenToCallPro: Call a licensed technician or electrician to verify polarity, grounding, and supply voltage.
snippetAnswer: Tempstar furnace code 10 Flash means the furnace detected reversed line polarity, or incorrect transformer phasing on twinned units on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: ICP control boards covered by document 44001202103 and using its 2–10 flash table.
